meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测主机资源限制并输出JSON快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要了解本地机器资源限制后再运行任务
copy.tagline_en: Detect host resource limits and output JSON snapshot
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know your local machine's resource limits before running tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会在计算密集任务开始前先检测本机资源:CPU核心数、GPU(含NVIDIA/AMD/Apple Silicon)、内存、磁盘空间,并在当前目录生成 .claude_resources.json 文件,内含资源实测值和并行、内存、GPU加速、大数据处理等策略建议。
howto.when: 当你要求做资源感知规划,或开始数据分析、模型训练等计算密集任务时触发。

say.text: 先检测这台机器的CPU、内存和磁盘,再开始分析
say.note: Claude会运行检测脚本并给出资源报告

say.text: 我要训练神经网络,看看有没有可用的GPU
处理10万个文件,帮我确定并行worker数
say.note: 根据核心数推荐并行worker数

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude detects CPU, GPU (NVIDIA/AMD/Apple Silicon), memory, and disk before compute-intensive tasks, and writes .claude_resources.json with resource measurements and strategy recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered at the start of compute-intensive tasks or when the user asks for resource-aware planning, for example before data analysis, model training, or parallel processing.

say_en.text: Check CPU, memory, and disk on this machine before starting
say_en.note: Claude runs the detection script and reports resources.

say_en.text: I want to train a neural network; check for available GPUs
say_en.note: Detects GPUs and available backends like CUDA/Metal.

say_en.text: Handling 10,000 files; recommend the number of parallel workers
say_en.note: Recommends workers based on core count.
